files.description: Primary (b)(10) EHI Export documentation. 10-page PDF describing the proprietary XML-based export format, 70+ document types covering wound care clinical data, document relationships, signatures, and file references. References a companion Data Dictionary that is not publicly available. Dated November 2023, authored by Amanda Quinones at Net Health.

FHIR R4 API documentation for (g)(10) compliance. 40-page PDF covering US Core profiles for standard USCDI clinical data (allergies, care plans, conditions, encounters, goals, immunizations, labs, medications, patient demographics, procedures, vitals, implantable devices, etc.). Separate system from the (b)(10) export.
Integration API registration guide. 51-page PDF describing the process to register as a vendor and obtain API keys for the i-heal integration API. Part of the pre-FHIR integration framework.
Integration API authentication guide. 28-page PDF covering user authentication, password management, and facility authorization for the i-heal integration API.
Integration API patient search guide. 22-page PDF describing patient search and demographics access APIs.

Integration API C-CDA data request guide. 8-page PDF documenting the CcdaGet API for retrieving Common Clinical Data Sets per patient visit in C-CDA format. Covers only standard clinical summary data (allergies, encounters, immunizations, medications, problems, procedures, vitals, etc.) — a narrower scope than the (b)(10) export.
Saved HTML of the main certification page containing all documentation links. Simple WordPress page with three sections: API Documentation, Mandatory Disclosure, and Real World Test Plan.
Full-page screenshot of the certification page captured in browser, showing all documentation links and page structure.
